items.rationale: The evaluator counts, paired effect, resample count, and interval map exactly to packet fields, but the linked evidence never states an 18-cell design or establishes the descriptors 'original' and 'frozen'. Those material design qualifiers therefore transmit more information than the packet contains.
decisive_evidence: paired_analysis: effect_definition 'condition B minus condition A', mean_paired_effect -0.2222222222222222, bootstrap_resamples 10000, ci95_low -0.4166666666666667, ci95_high -0.08333333333333333

items.rationale: The packet defines nine pairs, four paths per pair, all four derivations, and the no-rerun boundary. However, 'nine_shared_pairs_bound: true' does not operationally identify 36 branch registries plus nine evidence trees, state that each was hash-bound, or establish that binding occurred before evaluator inference.
decisive_evidence: execution_boundary: The controller, conclusion generator, and gate were not rerun.

items.rationale: Every count, rate, paired difference, p-value, revision, and model hash maps to a packet field. The qualifier 'cross-family' lacks a defined comparison class: the packet identifies the NLI model but provides no other model family against which cross-family status can be checked.
decisive_evidence: path_P0: evaluable 27, neutral_or_abstain 5, contradiction 0; path_P1/path_P2/path_P3: neutral_or_abstain 0, contradiction 0

items.rationale: Retention totals and the absence of revised-to-final content deltas are directly supported, as is the sample-bounded no-marginal-change interpretation. The exact assertion that identity held 'in all nine pairs' has no pair-count or pair-level identity field in this item's linked evidence, so that precision is not checkable from the packet.
decisive_evidence: retention: P1 retained 22 of 36; P2 retained 36 of 36; P3 retained 36 of 36
revised_to_final: claim_trace_count 36, change_types.unchanged 36, word_delta 0, character_delta 0, numeric_token_delta 0
scope_boundary: No observed marginal change in this artifact sample; not a general claim that rechecking is useless.

items.rationale: The packet supports no measured difference between P2 and P3 and explicitly denies prospective causal and semantic-preservation conclusions. It does not provide the P0 baseline or define which path corresponds to the first verification and delivery decision, so localization of an improvement to that stage is not established by this linked evidence.
decisive_evidence: observations: P1, P2, and P3 each have zero NLI non-entailment among evaluable claims; P2 and P3 are identical on all measured outcomes
explicit_limits: retrospective post-hoc design; three tasks; no human calibration; lexical proxies are not semantic-preservation ground truth

items.rationale: The claim is explicitly bounded to the reviewed set, and the packet states that this 12-record abstract/notes-based set does not establish a controlled ablation of an inserted claim-level evidence audit. A same-backbone, same-task, same-budget paired ablation immediately before delivery is a narrower member of that absent controlled-ablation class, while the stated limitations prevent extrapolation beyond the set.
decisive_evidence: review_scope: Bounded abstract/notes-based synthesis of 12 verified 2024-2026 records on autonomous scientific research agents and adjacent evidence-grounding systems.

gap_statement: The bounded reviewed set does not establish, via controlled ablation, whether inserting a claim-level evidence audit into an end-to-end research agent reduces hallucinated experimental details and unsupported conclusions.
limitations: absence from this set is not evidence that no prior work exists; abstract/notes based only; human full-text review is required before publication-grade novelty claims
